component: Qwen3.8 27B exact compact GDN speculative rollback
modifications: Generalized the existing correction-tape verify source to select arithmetic through an explicit typed fused-GDN contract; Qwen3.8 uses its existing Qwen3.5 swish and decay profile.
Added a Qwen3.8-owned exact state-plane provider that validates live ArraysCache ownership, cache geometry, speculative epoch, contract identity and memory benefit before compact replay runs.

Replaced S-1 full recurrent-state restore snapshots with one immutable pre-verify checkpoint, the final recurrent state, and a key/correction/decay tape. Partial acceptance reconstructs exactly from the checkpoint; full rejection and cancellation restore the checkpoint; full acceptance publishes the final state.
Kept selection adapter-owned, default-off, unqualified and separate from ordinary/reference decode. Unsupported or drifting state contracts refuse the compact path before publication.
Kept APCv2 persistent layout and namespace unchanged because the compact tape is transaction-local and never published as persistent approximate state.
boundaries: No GPU evidence, route qualification, default selection, full preflight, commit or publication is claimed. B1 Qwen3.8 compact replay is implemented; batched Qwen3.8 compact replay remains unimplemented.
